dct_description_sm: The objective is to contribute to ecosystem research in the High Arctic by conducting (1) basic quantitative documentation of ecosystem structure and processes; (2) baseline studies of intrinsic short-term and long-term variations in ecosystem functions; (3) retrospective analyses of organic and inorganic material to detect past ecosystem changes and (4) experimental studies enabling predictions of ecosystem responses to global changes.
dct_title_s: Fish and pinniped inventories of the northeast Greenland
